**WHO WE ARE**

  

Tealium is the Customer Data Infrastructure for a world where data is always moving. We connect the interaction, data, and experience layers so organizations can collect signals from anywhere, build context in real time, and activate it wherever it’s needed — across agents, apps, and physical devices.

  

More than 800 leading global brands trust Tealium to power their customer data strategies and deliver real-time, personalized experiences at scale.

  

Team Tealium has team members present in nearly 20 countries worldwide, serving customers across more than 30 countries. We win together with respect and appreciation for the talents required of all positions and the people who contribute to each of these. We are intentional about our WOWs (Ways of Work) culture, our investment in our team members, and how we care and connect.

  

With an extraordinary portfolio of investors (including Georgian, Silver Lake Waterman, Battery, and others) and deep industry experience, Tealium has the financial backing, profitability, and expertise to continue to outpace competitors and lead the way in innovation. Today, Tealium holds over 50 patents, and a few of the recent industry recognitions include:

* A Leader in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms
* 2025 TrustRadius Award Winner: Buyer’s Choice
* 2024 Invoca Partner Collaboration Award
* 2024 G2 Leader in Tag Management & Enterprise Data Governance
* Tealium Customer Data Hub achieved the Top Rated Award by TrustRadius (2024)
* Named on Destination CRM’s 2024 Top 100 Technologies List for Sales
* Named on the 2024 Best and Brightest in the Nation list
BuiltIn’s 2024 Best Place to Work  

  

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**  
  
We are looking for an Implementation Engineer to join our Field Engineering organization. The Implementation Engineer (IE) is a customer-facing technical partner who works closely with Account Teams and customers to drive successful implementations, accelerate platform adoption, and ensure measurable outcomes across the customer lifecycle.
  
  
This role goes beyond traditional implementation delivery. It requires a blend of technical consulting, solution design, customer data strategy, and data analysis to support complex customer environments. The IE serves as a trusted advisor, helping customers solve technical challenges, optimize their use of the platform, and realize sustained business value through proactive engagement and guidance.
  
  
We’re placing greater emphasis on individuals who can think strategically, operate independently, leverage AI and modern tools effectively, and drive efficient outcomes. Successful candidates will demonstrate strong ownership, resourcefulness, data-driven decision-making, adaptability, continuous learning, and a highly collaborative mindset across internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
This role also requires the ability to effectively leverage AI-powered tools and modern workflows to accelerate implementation delivery, improve data quality and troubleshooting, and enhance customer outcomes at scale.
  
  
**YOUR DAY TO DAY**

  

* Proactively support customer adoption, expansion, and technical success across proof of value, implementation, and forward-deployed engagements.
* Collaborate with customers, account teams, and partners to design and implement end-to-end solutions that connect data collection, enrichment, activation, and measurement to clear business and AI-driven outcomes
* Lead discovery and solutioning sessions to clarify goals, validate feasibility, assess customer architectures and implementation maturity, and identify technical risks, adoption blockers, optimization opportunities, and new use cases.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customer stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts across data, marketing, IT, and emerging AI-focused use cases in a clear and actionable way
* Leverage AI tools and modern workflows (including code assistants, automation, and analytics copilots) to accelerate implementation delivery, improve solution quality, and surface insights more efficiently
* Use SQL, data analysis, visualization, and AI-assisted analytics to validate data quality, identify patterns, and generate scalable, customer-ready insights and recommendations
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues across JavaScript tags, APIs, SDKs, integrations, and data pipelines, using both traditional debugging methods and AI-assisted diagnostic approaches to accelerate resolution
* Support proof of value and expansion opportunities by identifying technical requirements, validating solution fit, documenting key decisions and next steps, and applying deep expertise in Tealium’s solutions across customer engagements.
* Identify, evaluate, and implement AI-enabled and modern tooling opportunities to improve implementation efficiency, reduce manual effort, accelerate time-to-value, and optimize delivery outcomes at scale.
Act as a bridge between technical execution and business outcomes, ensuring every implementation is tied to measurable customer value and long-term success  

  

**WHAT YOU BRING TO TEALIUM**

  

* Experience working with Tealium products and solutions is strongly preferred.
* 3+ years of experience in client-facing technical roles such as implementation, solutions consulting, technical support, or customer-facing engineering within a SaaS, digital technology, martech, or data environment.
* Strong experience in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues related to tagging, APIs, SDKs, integrations, data discrepancies, and front-end implementations in complex customer environments
* Deep familiarity with digital marketing technologies, tag management, customer data platforms, digital analytics, and data/AI-driven workflows across web, mobile, and connected applications
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI-powered tools and modern workflows (e.g., code assistants, analytics copilots, automation tools) to accelerate debugging, improve solution quality, and increase delivery efficiency
* Proficiency with SQL and data analysis to validate implementations, assess data quality, identify issues, and generate actionable customer insights and recommendations
* Expert in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Python, JS frameworks, and experience in mobile frameworks or other coding languages.
* Ability to lead customer-facing discussions, manage expectations, navigate escalated issues, and collaborate effectively across internal teams, partners, and customers.
* Continuous learner with a strong interest in emerging technologies, especially AI-enabled tooling and modern implementation practice.
* Ability and willingness to travel approximately **20%** to support customer engagements, onsite meetings, and other business needs.

  

WAGE TRANSPARENCY

  

In many U.S. states, employers are required to include a pay range for posted positions. Although this isn't a requirement in every state, communicating transparently is a cornerstone of our operations at Tealium, and we believe in making this information available to all applicants.

  

The U.S. pay range for this full-time position is listed below, however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is eligible for a robust benefits package that includes the following:

* Employees are eligible to receive an annual bonus and stock options.
* Employees and their families are eligible for medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance.
* Employees have the option to enroll in our 401k plan and are eligible to receive contributions for company matching.
* Employees are eligible for flexible paid time-off and extended paid parental leave.
* We offer 11 paid holidays annually
* We offer 15 hours of paid work time for volunteer activities and programs.
* Our sick leave accrual is the following for our employees:
  + Exempt CA employees (not including San Francisco) including NY : accrue 40 hours each year. Unused sick leave carries over into the next year. Employees cannot exceed 80 hours in a given year.
  + Exempt Non - CA employees (not including NY) including SF: Accrue 1 hour every 30 hours worked. Cannot exceed 180 hours in the calendar year.
  Non-Exempt: accrue 1 hour every 30 hours worked. Unused carries over to the next year. Not to exceed 108 hours in a calendar year.

**The Team You'll Join**
========================

  
At First American, we help people and businesses navigate every stage of the real estate journey with confidence. From title insurance and settlement services to valuation, data, and technology solutions, our teams work together to simplify complex transactions and protect one of life's most important investments. Across every area of our company, our team members are integral to moving the First American mission forward. Come build your future alongside people who genuinely care about your success and the difference you make.

**The Impact You'll Make**
==========================

  
The Project Manager-Implementation supports the successful deployment of new platforms, processes, and operating models across the organization. Partners with business teams, Product, Technology, Training, Support, and other cross-functional stakeholders to coordinate implementation activities from readiness and launch through hyper care, stabilization, and transition to ongoing operations. Provides structure and visibility across complex implementations by monitoring progress, identifying risks and dependencies, facilitating issue resolution, and supporting data-informed decision-making. Contributes to consistent, scalable implementation practices and continuous improvement across future rollouts.

**HOW YOU’LL CONTRIBUTE**

* Coordinates implementation activities across the lifecycle, including readiness, launch, hyper care, stabilization, and transition to ongoing operations.
* Partners with business and technical teams to align implementation plans, activities, dependencies, milestones, and responsibilities.
* Maintains implementation plans, playbooks, tools, documentation, and established readiness and transition criteria.
* Establishes and supports cross-functional operating cadences for implementation coordination, issue resolution, escalation, and decision-making.
* Identifies and tracks risks, issues, blockers, and dependencies; ensures appropriate ownership, action planning, escalation, and follow-through.
* Monitors implementation, adoption, support, and operational performance indicators to assess rollout health and identify emerging concerns.
* Synthesizes operational data, stakeholder feedback, and implementation observations to identify trends and areas requiring attention.
* Develops concise status reporting that provides stakeholders and leaders visibility into implementation progress, risks, issues, trends, and required decisions.
* Facilitates cross-functional problem solving and coordinates timely communication of critical information to appropriate stakeholders.
* Captures lessons learned and identifies opportunities to improve and standardize implementation processes, tools, and practices across future rollout activities.
* Other duties as assigned

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

Required Education, Experience, Certification/Licensure

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Typically have 4+ years of related experience.
* Experience in implementation, program or project management, business operations, operational readiness, deployment, or a related field.
* Experience coordinating complex initiatives across multiple business and technical teams.
* Experience identifying and managing project or implementation risks, issues, dependencies, actions, and escalations.
* Experience supporting enterprise technology, platform, process, or operating-model implementations preferred.
* Experience with go-live, hyper care, stabilization, adoption, or large-scale implementation activities preferred.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES (KSAs)**

* Strong organizational and project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, activities, and dependencies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret operational data, identify trends, and translate information into action.
* Ability to synthesize complex information and communicate key findings, risks, and priorities clearly to different audiences.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to build effective cross-functional relationships and influence outcomes without direct authority.
* Ability to identify risks and issues proactively and facilitate appropriate resolution and escalation.
* Knowledge of implementation, operational readiness, adoption, and stabilization practices.
* Familiarity with dashboards, key performance indicators, and operational performance reporting.
* Ability to work effectively across business, Product, Technology, Support, Training, and Change Management functions.
* Ability to adapt and remain effective in fast-paced, evolving environments.

  

**Pay, Benefits, and Support**
==============================

  
Pay Range: $85,000.00 - $113,300.00 Annually This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location. Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan. Our people first culture is built on creating a workplace where different perspectives are welcomed, respected, and valued. We believe teams are stronger when employees feel supported, included, and encouraged to contribute as themselves. Here, you’ll be part of a culture built on collaboration, respect, accountability, and continuous improvement — so you can do meaningful work, grow your career, and help move our customers, communities, and company forward.

**About First American**
========================

First American Financial Corporation (NYSE: FAF) is a premier provider of title, settlement, and risk solutions for real estate transactions. Backed by financial strength and stability built over more than 135 years, the company is leading the digital transformation of the industry through continued investment in proprietary technologies, unmatched data assets, and scalable solutions designed for what’s next.

First American’s commitment to putting its people first has resulted in numerous accolades, including being named one of the 100 Best Companies to Work For by Great Place to Work® and Fortune Magazine for more than ten consecutive years. The company has also been included on the PEOPLE® Companies that Care and Fortune Best Workplaces lists for Financial Services and Insurance, in addition to earning national recognition as a best place to work for women, parents, and LGBTQ+ employees. These accolades reflect a workplace where collaboration, respect, accountability, and continuous improvement guide how we work together every day.

Learn more about the company at www.firstam.com.

\*\*Note that the following statements only apply to candidates who will be working from an unincorporated area within Los Angeles County.\*\*

First American will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws (e.g., the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act).

First American intends to conduct a review of an applicant’s criminal history in connection with a conditional offer. First American reasonably believes that a criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following material job duties for this position potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: handling of confidential, proprietary or trade secret information belonging to First American or its customers, administering or facilitating financial transactions, and the ability to meet customer-imposed criminal history requirements.

For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

* + Design and document new use cases for our platform.
  + Train our internal and external teams through webinars
  + Contribute to our knowledge base and serve as a subject matter expert on the Platform
* Actively contribute to the development of new Platform features

jobs.title: Implementation Manager (Captain of Go-Live)
jobs.description:
Do you feel more in your element, not less, when a project has six stakeholders, three departments, and a deadline that actually matters to someone's budget? Can you read an RFP or a draft SOW and spot the commitment that will blow up month four of an implementation before anyone has signed anything? Do you get more satisfaction from watching your team land a go-live than from landing it yourself? Can you spot a risk quietly building across two different workstreams, or across five people's portfolios, before anyone else notices it? Do you already reach for AI to move faster through complex data and document work, and coach your team to do the same? Are you the person other teams call when an enterprise account needs someone steady at the helm? If so, keep reading...

The team at RTA is looking for an Implementation Manager: our Enterprise Orchestrator, Team Coach, and Fleet360 Authority all rolled into one. Reporting to the CTO, you'll lead RTA's implementation team of enterprise and non-enterprise Implementation Specialists. You'll own the delivery of every customer onboarding from signed contract through a confident go-live.

You'll hire, coach, and hold accountable the specialists who run every engagement, and step in as the escalation point when an enterprise account needs a steady hand. Your work starts before the contract is signed. You'll partner with Sales during the enterprise pre-sales process to review RFPs, SOWs, and contract language, so that what we promise is something we can actually deliver. You'll coordinate across Sales, Fleet Consulting, Training, Support, and CSM (Customer Success Management), catch risk across the whole portfolio before it threatens a timeline, and make sure every customer arrives at go-live confident, not just converted. This position plays a direct role in RTA's mission to help fleets succeed, starting with the customers who trust us with the most.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

In general, someone who:

* Feels at home being a member of a healthy team. This means they aren't afraid to mix it up or be held accountable by the team, and they are willing to hold others accountable as well. People with trust issues and insecurity need not apply. No, seriously.
* Passionately cares about our clients and helping them be more successful. Our clients are fleet managers, parts clerks, and automotive technicians who maintain everything from squad cars to school buses so that everyone comes home safely at the end of the day.
* Thinks of themselves less, while not thinking less of themselves. They are other-centric, compassionate, and self-assured.
* Is willing to lift boxes, clean floors, and hold doors if that's what it takes to get something done, because no job is beneath them.
* Takes ownership and initiative. They identify how to make processes better without waiting to be told, and practice Extreme Ownership when things go sideways.
* Loves to read, learn, grow, and stretch themselves through goal setting and daily habits. Bonus points for each book you've read by Patrick Lencioni.
* Wants to be part of a leadership team that constantly challenges and stretches each other's abilities. We don't do echo chambers here.

**Specifically for This Role, Someone Who:**
--------------------------------------------

**Leads and develops the team**

* Has led and managed an implementation, onboarding, or professional services team for a software product, and loves helping others excel in their work.
* Sets clear expectations, runs effective 1:1s, gives direct feedback early, and creates a culture where people grow and do their best work. Part coach, part bulldozer: you seek and destroy the obstacles blocking your team.
* Holds specialists accountable to timelines, quality, and scope, and has the hard conversation when performance isn't there, rather than quietly absorbing the work yourself.
* Recruits, onboards, and retains strong implementers, and builds onboarding plans that get new specialists running implementations on their own quickly.
* Balances workload across the team: assigns new engagements based on capacity and complexity, and sees an overloaded portfolio before it becomes a missed go-live.
* Understands the value of metrics, knows what to track and how to track it, and makes staffing, process, and tooling decisions from the data.

**Reviews enterprise documents before the deal is signed**

* Partners with Sales during the enterprise pre-sales process, reviewing RFPs, SOWs, contracts, and statements of requirements for implementation scope, timeline, data migration, integration, and staffing commitments.
* Reads requirement language line by line and flags anything vague, unrealistic, or out of scope, then proposes the language that fixes it before it becomes a commitment we have to keep.
* Contributes the implementation sections of RFP responses and SOWs: approach, timeline, roles, assumptions, and customer responsibilities.
* Turns the signed documents into the implementation plan, so the team delivers against what was actually contracted, not what someone remembers from the sales call.

**Owns enterprise delivery**

* Owns timeline and sequencing across the team's full implementation portfolio.
* Coordinates explicitly across Sales, Fleet Consulting, Training, Support, and CSM at defined handoff points, keeping every team's commitments visible instead of assumed.
* Proactively surfaces risk, including cross-departmental dependencies that are quietly stalling, and brings a mitigation plan instead of just a flag.
* Guides customers, including senior fleet and operations leaders, through high-stakes configuration decisions with enough credibility that they trust your judgment, not just your process.
* Builds confidence with enterprise customers by communicating proactively, setting clear expectations, and creating trust long before issues ever arise. You are the escalation point when a customer relationship gets tense.
* Holds the agreed scope line with customers, knowing when a variation needs documentation, an addendum, or a real escalation, and coaches the team to do the same.
* Owns data migration quality across the team. You can clean, compile, and migrate data into Fleet360 yourself, and you're comfortable with nested formulas, multi-condition logic, and multi-tab interconnected workbooks. You also set the standard and review the work so migration errors don't reach go-live.
* Builds and refines implementation processes, playbooks, and templates that scale as the enterprise pipeline grows.
* Operates with an AI-first mindset and makes the team AI-first too: using AI to speed up document review, data analysis, customer communication, and project execution, while knowing exactly when human judgment is required. This one is not optional here.

RTA's biggest customers carry the most people, the most vehicles, and the most on the line if something falls through the cracks. You're the one making sure your whole team holds it together, from the first RFP question to the last go-live checklist item. Are you the reason it comes together instead of falling apart? Let's find out.

**This Role Probably Is Not for You if...**
-------------------------------------------

* You want to manage from a dashboard. You'll be in the RFPs, the escalation calls, and the data reviews alongside your team.
* You'd rather be the best implementer than build a team of them. Your success is measured by the team's go-lives, not your own.
* You avoid hard conversations. Holding a specialist accountable, or telling Sales that an RFP commitment isn't deliverable, is part of the job.
* You think contracts and RFPs are Sales' problem. If you'd rather find out what we promised at kickoff, this isn't your role.
* You want one team and one clear lane. This role coordinates Sales, Fleet Consulting, Training, Support, and CSM across every engagement, often all at once.
* You wait for someone else to flag risk. If a dependency or a specialist's portfolio is quietly stalling, naming it and building the mitigation plan is your job.
* You treat scope creep as a later problem. On accounts this size, an undocumented variation can turn into real financial or timeline exposure fast.
* You think using AI is cutting corners, or you're waiting for someone else to figure out how it fits your job. At RTA, that's not a personality quirk. It's a mismatch with the role.

**Key Results Areas (aka the Job Outcomes)**
--------------------------------------------

* Hit the agreed go-live date on at least 90% of the team's engagements each quarter, with at-risk timelines surfaced with a mitigation plan at least 2 weeks before they slip.
* Review 100% of enterprise RFPs, SOWs, and contracts for implementation commitments before submission or signature, returning comments to Sales within 3 business days.
* Zero signed enterprise commitments for implementation scope, timeline, or staffing that the team can't deliver as written.
* Maintain a customer satisfaction rating of 90% or higher across the team's completed implementations each quarter.
* Zero downstream data-quality escalations traced back to migration error, across the team.
* Log 100% of customer scope variations in the account record, escalating any that require an addendum within 2 business days of identification.
* Achieve 95% completion of internal implementation milestones on or before committed dates, so downstream teams receive clean, complete handoffs.
* Build and retain a high-performing team: low regrettable attrition, a documented development plan for every specialist, and new hires running implementations on their own within 90 days.
* Put at least one new AI-assisted workflow into practice across the team each quarter that measurably speeds up document review, data work, customer communication, or troubleshooting.

**Qualifications**
------------------

OK, the boring HR part of the job posting that looks like every other posting out there, but it's necessary:

* 7+ years in customer-facing implementation, onboarding, professional services, or project management roles; B2B SaaS (Software as a Service) strongly preferred
* 2+ years directly managing people, ideally a team of 4 or more implementers, consultants, or project managers
* Hands-on experience reviewing RFPs, SOWs, MSAs (Master Service Agreements), or similar contract documents for delivery scope and risk; public sector procurement experience a strong plus
* Track record leading complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise implementations from kickoff through go-live
* Proficient with Microsoft 365, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint, with comfort in nested formulas, multi-condition logic, and multi-tab interconnected workbooks
* Experience with project/ticket tracking tools (e.g., JIRA) and CRM (Customer Relationship Management) tools (e.g., HubSpot)
* Comfortable leading conversations with senior fleet and operations leaders, including high-stakes configuration decisions and scope pushback
* Demonstrated, real-world use of AI tools to increase speed or accuracy in your own work and your team's, with specific examples you can speak to
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; you write clearly enough that your redlines and comments don't need a follow-up meeting
* Fleet, fleet-adjacent, or public sector operations experience preferred, not required. We define this broadly:  
  + Direct fleet or asset operations: fleet manager, shop supervisor, maintenance coordinator, or municipal, school, and EMS fleet operations
  + Fleet-adjacent industries: transportation and logistics, public works, construction or utilities equipment, waste management
  + Fleet-adjacent software: implementation or onboarding experience with other fleet, asset, or maintenance management platforms
* Exposure to SQL (Structured Query Language) or structured databases preferred, not required
* Bachelor's degree not required. Relevant experience and breadth of knowledge matter more

Nick Fury never threw a punch. He assembled the team, coordinated the moving parts, and made sure everyone showed up in the right place at the right time. Think you can do that for an entire implementation team? Prove it.

**The Bottom Line**
-------------------

You've made it this far, congratulations. We're looking for an ideal team player with an almost frightening intensity around orchestration, credibility, and follow-through. That means someone who can build a team that holds six-team engagements together without losing sight of a single open item, and who catches the bad commitment in the RFP before it ever reaches the team. If you feel a quiet thrill when a complicated account lands exactly where it's supposed to, on time and without drama, and even more when your team lands it, we want to talk.

**Compensation & Work Location**
--------------------------------

* Total compensation for this role is between $120,000 and $135,000 based on experience.
* This is a full-time, fully remote-eligible role, including for candidates based in the Phoenix metro area.
* First week onboarding onsite at RTA HQ in Glendale, AZ required.
* Occasional visits to RTA HQ for team events should be expected.
* Travel to customer sites for pre-sales meetings, kickoffs, and go-lives is up to 10% annually, based on business needs.
* This position is classified as exempt and is not eligible for overtime pay.

**Why Top Talent Chooses RTA**
------------------------------

We invest in our people — period.

* 401(k) with 6% Safe Harbor match (100% vested day one)
* Flexible PTO model built on trust and manager-approved time off
* Cigna PPO and HSA medical plan options with company contributions ($780–$1,950 annually)
* Garner Health HRA program: up to $1,000 individual / $2,000 family reimbursement opportunity
* Wellness rewards up to $350 annually
* Virtual care and mental health support resources
* Company-sponsored benefits including dental, vision, EAP, life, STD, LTD, legal plan, and identity theft protection options
* Additional employee perks, wellness initiatives, and discount programs

**The Part We're Most Proud Of**
--------------------------------

* 99% of employees say RTA is a Great Place to Work® (Certified 3 years running)
* 30% ARR growth — two years straight
* We are an AI-forward company building for the future
* We see you. You have been reading this for seven minutes. Just apply already.

**About Us**
------------

RTA has been established since 1979 and has the reputation of providing the best customer service in the market. Our purpose is to help fleets succeed. We pride ourselves on creating a caring, family-oriented atmosphere for both staff and clients, and love that our work makes a positive impact on all the lives we touch. Our clients carry kids in school buses, first responders in emergency vehicles, patients in ambulances, food and medical supplies in trucks, and people just taking the bus or train to work. We do meaningful work, and we want our clients to have the best tools available to them.

Our office spaces are open, spacious, and colorful, with an abundance of natural light. We come together often as a company to enjoy freshly baked desserts or awesome lunches, and genuinely enjoy each other's company. We offer some pretty unique perks and benefits, as well as all the standard ones. We're happy to talk through all the options.

**Physical & Travel Requirements**
----------------------------------

* Ability to sit or stand for extended periods
* Ability to work at a computer for prolonged periods
* Ability to travel up to 10%
* Ability to travel to the company headquarters for Onboarding

**Heading to RTA HQ?**
----------------------

Coming from the east side? You'll enjoy waving at the traffic going the other way while never having to stare at the blinding sun. It only takes about 25 minutes to get here from downtown Scottsdale in the mornings. We are located close to Arrowhead Mall, with quick access to the 101 from multiple directions. If all of this sounds like you, and your type of company, then click apply. Seriously, we've asked you four times now, and you are still reading. Bonus points for being thorough.

**Reasonable Accommodation**
----------------------------

RTA is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process or perform the essential functions of this role, please notify us at hr@rtafleet.com.

**Employment Notices**
----------------------

Employment with RTA is at-will. This means either the employee or the company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law.

Employment with RTA may be contingent upon successful completion of a background check and other pre-employment screenings, consistent with applicable law.

We cannot accept student visas or provide sponsorship at this time.

Notice Regarding the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Application Review

**Notice of AI Use in Job Application Review**

As part of our commitment in creating a fair, efficient, and consistent hiring process we may use artificial intelligence (AI) to help our recruiting teams organize, summarize, and analyze information provided by candidates, including resumes, application responses, and other materials submitted during the application process. AI may be used to identify patterns, highlight relevant skills, and experience, and assist in comparing a candidate's qualifications with the requirement of a specific role. These tools are to improve efficiency and consistency while supporting more informed hiring decisions, which will ultimately be made by the hiring team.

The Agency-Level EVV Training Specialist will be responsible for planning, developing, coordinating, and delivering training programs for Operations teams. The role requires a strong understanding of operational processes, systems, and business requirements, along with the ability to develop effective learning solutions that enhance employee knowledge, skills, and overall operational performance.
  
  
**Supervisory Responsibilities:**  
This position has no supervisory responsibilities.
  
  
**Duties/Responsibilities:**  
**Includes the following:**  
Plan and deliver instructor-led training sessions for Operations teams, covering soft skills, system-related functionalities, operational processes, and domain-specific knowledge.
  
  
Assist in the creation, review, and maintenance of training materials and learning artifacts, including presentations, training guides, handouts, knowledge assessments, and other supporting documentation.
  
  
Partner with Operations leadership to identify skill gaps and emerging training requirements and develop appropriate training interventions to address them in a timely and effective manner.
  
  
Ensure assigned and scheduled training programs are delivered within established timelines. Monitor trainee participation and completion to ensure adherence to training requirements.
  
  
Collect and analyze trainee feedback following each training session. Identify opportunities to improve training content, curriculum, and delivery methods to enhance learning effectiveness and knowledge retention.
  
  
Participate in discussions and collaborate with the Capgemini Learning & Development (L&D) team, as required, to align training initiatives, share best practices, and support organizational learning objectives.
  
  
Periodically review and analyze Operations QA scores to identify recurring errors, knowledge gaps, and performance improvement opportunities. Develop and recommend targeted training plans to address identified gaps.
  
  
Maintain accurate records and trackers for all Soft Skills, Operational, System, and Mandatory training programs conducted for Operations teams, including participation and completion status.
  
  
Support the review, development, and periodic updating of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process documents, and other operational reference materials to ensure alignment with current business practices.
  
  
Provide inputs and recommendations for designing and implementing new training approaches, methodologies, and learning frameworks, particularly for large-scale projects and new operational transitions.
  
  
Other duties may be assigned to meet business needs.
  
  
**Required Skills/Abilities:**  
Time/Task Management
  
  
Attention to detail
  
  
Strong communicating and presentation skill
  
  
Ability to guide, mentor, and support trainees
  
  
Analytical problem-solving capabilities
  
  
Experience in developing others through coaching, feedback, and knowledge sharing
  
  
Ability to establish and maintain effective stakeholder relationships
  
  
Confidence in interacting with leadership
  
  
Ability to foster a collaborative and continuous learning environment
  
  
Awareness of relevant technologies, systems, and digital learning tools
  
  
Willingness to adopt new tools, platforms, and technology-enabled learning methodologies.
  
  
Industry knowledge and understanding the importance and benefits of Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) for LTCIs, Claimants, Providers, Caregivers (Customer Base)
  
  
Effective communication and transfer of knowledge to EVV program to Customer Base
  
  
**Education and Experience:**  
Demonstrated understanding or experience in adult learning principles, training methodologies, and knowledge transfer, with a strong willingness and aptitude to learn new operational processes, systems, and domain-specific concepts
  
  
Excellent verbal communication, public speaking, and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently facilitate and lead training sessions for large groups
  
  
Experience in designing, coordinating, and delivering corporate training programs is preferred.
  
  
Proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, with the ability to develop engaging and professional training presentations
  
  
Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel for maintaining training trackers, analyzing basic data, and monitoring training completion
  
  
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word for preparing and maintaining training materials, process documents, and other learning resources
  
  
Prior experience in the US Healthcare domain is preferred but not mandatory
  
  
Demonstrated flexibility and willingness to work extended hours, when required, to support business and training needs
  
  
Ability to adapt to changing business priorities and take on additional responsibilities or assignments as needed
